Arsenal and Borussia Dortmund drew 1–1 in the Champions League. Viktor Gyökeres put Arsenal ahead in the 10th minute, set up by Noni Madueke.

Maximilian Beier levelled in the 55th minute, assisted by Kouakou Gadou.

Arsenal are now fifth with 11 points from five games, having dropped from third. Dortmund climbed from 12th to seventh and have 10 points from five. Arsenal's last five reads 3W 2D 0L, and their unbeaten run stands at 11.
